text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx and timeout rates observed for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 after a deploy at ~2026-03-14T04:12Z. p95 latency jumped from 230ms -> 1.8s, p99 -> 9.2s. Error rate +client-timeouts increased to 8%. Paging oncall.

jordan (oncall): I'm on it. first check: is this canary or prod rollout?

lee (sre): rollout show indicates a gradual canary finished and cutover to primary pool at 04:11:42Z. Deploy ID: deploy-2026-03-14-0410.

mira (runtime): seeing a KV cache eviction storm on pod pool-gamma-*. logs show repeated KV miss + rebuild, which is causing seq-length stalls. snippet:
```
[kvcache] evict key=conv-xyz reason=pressure size=0.12MB
[request] load_kv_cache took=152ms
[serving] token_gen first_token_delay=420ms tail_latency=1.1s
```

sam (platform): @mira can you confirm this aligns with the new kernel selector change from the last commit? there was a fallback tweak in the allocator.

mira (runtime): yes, commit 7a9f2 switched kernel-selection thresholds for long-prefix workloads. seems like a corner case where sequence-prefetch isn't warming.

jordan (oncall): customers seeing 504s at the gateway? support reports spikes. @alyssa please gather customer-impact list.

alyssa (support): collecting. so far two mid-market customers reporting model completions tripping timeouts, one chatbot experience degraded. raising sev-2 for business impact. will DM logs and top traces.

lee (sre): mitigation plan: 1) roll back deploy to prior stable (deploy-2026-03-14-0330) 2) scale dedicated pools to absorb backlog 3) temporary routing to warm cache variant (model-quantized-warm).

jordan (oncall): rollbacks take ~2-3m to drain. do it. @deploy-bot initiate rollback to deploy-2026-03-14-0330 now.

deploy-bot: Rolling back service: inference-api, target: deploy-2026-03-14-0330. Initiated by jordan (oncall). ETA rotation 180s.

mira (runtime): while rollback is in progress, enable prefix-KV sticky routing for existing connections: `route: prefer=warm_kv` live flag on. setting now.

sam (platform): manual scale +2 replicas on region eu-west-1 pool-gamma. command: `infra scale pool-gamma --replicas +2 --reason "rollback drain"`

lee (sre): monitoring: p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 650ms within 90s of rollback start; p99 trending down from 9s -> 2.4s. error-rate falling from 8% -> 1.6%.

jordan (oncall): good. @alyssa confirm if any customer SLAs crossed and which ones. need list for incident report.

alyssa (support): confirmed: one customer exceeded 99.9% per-minute availability for a 3-minute window, another had degraded tail latency impacting session UX. I'll compile impact table and notify account managers.

mira (runtime): rollback completed at 04:15:50Z per deploy-bot. verifying kernel selector reverted. logs show KV warmup happening as expected.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: inference-api -> deploy-2026-03-14-0330. Duration: 188s.

lee (sre): verifying downstream: gateway 504s reduced to baseline. p95 now at 210ms, p99 ~480ms. marking immediate mitigation successful.

jordan (oncall): starting a quick postmortem checklist: 1) revert commit flagged for kernel threshold changes to a feature branch 2) add e2e perf test for KV warmup under canary 3) improve alerting to correlate KV-eviction spikes with p99 tail 4) notify impacted customers.

sam (platform): will add a pre-cutover gating check to canary pipeline to validate KV hit-rate and first-token latency for representative traces.

alyssa (support): notifications drafted. sending to affected customers now with timeline + apology + mitigations.

mira (runtime): temporary follow-up: will push a tweak to lower kernel threshold on canary branch and run internal load tests; will not ship to prod until we have a warmup validation.

jordan (oncall): handing off monitoring and follow-ups to lee (SRE) for the night shift. I'll write up the incident summary in #postmortems after we collect logs. Next oncall please pick up ownership at 06:00Z.

lee (sre): acknowledged, taking handoff. I'll keep dashboard pinned and will create alert rule for KV-eviction > 50/min correlated with p99 > 2s.

jordan (oncall): one-liner for handoff message: post-deploy timeout regression due to KV-cache warmup regression from kernel-selector change; rollback completed, customer impact limited but non-zero; follow-ups assigned to runtime/platform/support.

incident-bot: Incident tagged: rollback-complete, severity downgraded to sev-3. Incident channel thread closed for active remediation.

alyssa (support): thanks team. will attach customer impact doc to the postmortem. :thumbsup:

mira (runtime): will paste initial logs & perf graphs to the postmortem page in ~30m.

lee (sre): closing notes: no data exposure. follow-ups prioritized: perf test, canary gating, alerting. handing off to next oncall.

jordan (oncall): thanks everyone. good catch and quick rollback.
